entities.summary: Dariusz Maciej Grabowski is a Polish politician and former Member of the European Parliament (MEP) for the Masovian Voivodship with the League of Polish Families, part of the Union for Europe of the Nations Group and sits on the European Parliament's Committee on Budgets.
